ruleDefinitions.name: Scheduled Task Executed Uncommon LOLBIN
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of Scheduled Tasks where the program being run is located in a suspicious location or where it is an unusual program to be run from a Scheduled Task Note: Unmapped fields: Path

sequences.query: (event_id = 129 AND (Path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR Path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR Path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR Path = RGX("\\\\mspaint\\\.exe$") OR Path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") OR Path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR Path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")))
